panels.description: One rest-frame K1 optical-clock panel with a horizontal rod AB and a forward/return light path above it.

points.label: O1
points.position: To the left of A on the rod's bottom baseline.

points.label: A
points.position: Left end of the single filled rod, on the baseline.

points.label: B
points.position: Right end of the rod, on the baseline.
Above A on the upper light track.
Above B on the upper light track.
Above B on the lower light track.
Above A on the lower light track.
Below A on the dimension line.
Below B on the dimension line.

relationships.fact: X1, Y1 and Z1 axes share O1 and have outward arrowheads.
O1, A, B and X1 tip lie on one horizontal line in that left-to-right order.
The filled rod begins at A and ends at B.
The upper optical track runs from the A end toward the B end with a rightward arrow.
The lower optical track runs from the B end toward the A end with a leftward arrow.
Both optical tracks are parallel to AB; their endpoint supports align vertically with A and B.
The double-ended dimension below the rod spans the projections of A and B and is labelled l0.
Vertical end supports connect the rod/light apparatus and continue to the dimension baseline.

givenValues: Rest length l0, symbolic rather than numeric

interpretationBoundary: The optical clock is the AB light round trip, not an added clock face. Opposite optical arrows and the l0 dimension are source facts.
